title: generate-ux-pack input
description: ENFORCED — the engine validates this ASSEMBLED stage input against this schema BEFORE the stage runs (engine/validation.py validate_stage_input; fail-closed, engine/config/runtime-binding.yaml input_validation: enforce). Shape below is the POST-adapter payload delivered at stage ux-intake.

requester.description: From workflow input: who asked for this run (named human; provenance in the pack README).

epics.description: engine-hydrated: the ba-brief manifest's epic refs dereferenced into inline epic sidecar objects (see eliciting-banking-brief schemas/epic-sidecar.json).

story_files.description: The manifest's original story file refs, retained alongside the hydrated stories.

stories.description: engine-hydrated: mapping.py _hydrate_ba_research adds this key by dereferencing story_files into inline story sidecar objects (see eliciting-banking-brief schemas/story-sidecar.json). Authoritative source for which stories need UX coverage; story ids copied EXACTLY (e.g. STORY-CHECKOUT-01).

idempotency_key.description: engine-injected: the workflow's single idempotency key. First 8 chars form the pack dir suffix (ux-design-{idem8}); retries validate/update the same pack — never a fresh UUID.

upstream_artifacts.description: engine-injected: map of producer stage id to its artifact path relative to this stage's dir.

loop_back_feedback.description: engine-injected (conditional): reviewer findings threaded into a re-run after a loop_back.
